# Final Review Arbiter
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

Rejected the sole disputed amendment because the strongest concrete evidence identifies the diff as the `tanksim-6e5.4.7` alkalinity worktree, while the accept position depends on an unsupported assumption that the patch was intended to implement `tanksim-6e5.7.2`.

## Rulings

- `fr-3-2eb078b6`: Reject
  The record does not establish that the reviewed patch was actually meant to satisfy `tanksim-6e5.7.2`. Every concrete file reference in the amendment points into `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/...`, and the cited changes are alkalinity-budget plumbing that reviewer 2 specifically explains as matching bead `tanksim-6e5.4.7`. By contrast, the planner and the accepting reviewer both make their support conditional on the unproven premise that this patch was being reviewed as `6e5.7.2`. On the evidence provided, this is more convincingly a task-tracking mixup than a blocker in the patch itself.
